   559	
   560	def _read_result_file(
   560	def _read_result_file(
   561	    result_path: Path,
   562	    *,
   563	    backend: str,
   564	    logs: Mapping[str, str],
   565	) -> Any:
   566	    try:
   567	        result_stat = result_path.lstat()
   568	    except FileNotFoundError:
   569	        raise_invalid_artifact_error(
   570	            backend=backend,
   571	            message=f"renderer did not write its authoritative result file: {result_path}",
   572	            details={"result_path": str(result_path), **logs},
   573	        )
   574	    except OSError as exc:
   575	        raise_invalid_artifact_error(
   576	            backend=backend,
   577	            message=f"cannot inspect renderer result file: {result_path}",
   578	            details={
   579	                "result_path": str(result_path),
   580	                "error_type": type(exc).__name__,
   581	                **logs,
   582	            },
   583	        )
   584	    if stat.S_ISLNK(result_stat.st_mode) or not stat.S_ISREG(result_stat.st_mode):
   585	        raise_invalid_artifact_error(
   586	            backend=backend,
   587	            message=f"renderer result path is not a regular file: {result_path}",
   588	            details={"result_path": str(result_path), **logs},
   589	        )
   590	    try:
   591	        return json.loads(result_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
   592	    except (json.JSONDecodeError, UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:
   593	        raise_protocol_error(
   594	            backend=backend,
   595	            message=f"renderer wrote malformed result JSON: {exc}",
   596	            details={
   597	                "result_path": str(result_path),
   598	                "error_type": type(exc).__name__,
   599	                **logs,
   600	            },
   601	        )
   602	    except OSError as exc:
   603	        raise_invalid_artifact_error(
   604	            backend=backend,
   605	            message=f"cannot read renderer result file: {result_path}",
   606	            details={
   607	                "result_path": str(result_path),
   608	                "error_type": type(exc).__name__,
   609	                **logs,
   610	            },
   611	        )

   613	
   614	def _parse_result(
   615	    verb: str,
   616	    payload: Any,
   617	    *,
   618	    backend: str,
   619	    logs: Mapping[str, str],
   620	) -> CommandResult:
   621	    if isinstance(payload, Mapping) and "kind" in payload:
   622	        try:
   623	            emitted_error = RendererError.from_dict(payload)
   624	        except RendererException as exc:
   625	            _raise_requalified(exc, backend=backend, logs=logs)
   626	        if emitted_error.backend != backend:
   627	            raise_protocol_error(
   628	                backend=backend,
   629	                message="renderer error result names a different backend",
   630	                details={"reported_backend": emitted_error.backend, **logs},
   631	            )
   632	        raise_renderer_error(
   633	            replace(
   634	                emitted_error,
   635	                details={**emitted_error.details, **logs},
   636	            )
   637	        )
   638	
   639	    parser: Any
   640	    if verb in {"render", "finalize"}:
   641	        parser = RenderResult.from_dict
   642	    elif verb == "support":
   643	        parser = SupportReport.from_dict
   644	    else:
   645	        parser = RenderPlan.from_dict
   646	
   647	    try:
   648	        parsed = parser(payload)
   649	    except RendererException as exc:
   650	        _raise_requalified(exc, backend=backend, logs=logs)
   651	
   652	    if isinstance(parsed, SupportReport) and parsed.backend != backend:
   653	        raise_protocol_error(
   654	            backend=backend,
   655	            message="support report names a different backend",
   656	            details={"reported_backend": parsed.backend, **logs},
   657	        )

   659	        raise_protocol_error(
   660	            backend=backend,
   661	            message="render plan names a different planner",
   662	            details={"reported_backend": parsed.planner.id, **logs},
   663	        )

   665	        captured = [
   666	            f"{stream}:\n{text}"
   667	            for stream, text in logs.items()
   668	            if text.strip()
   669	        ]
   670	        parsed = replace(
   671	            parsed,
   672	            logs=[
   673	                _redact_log(log, secret_values=()) for log in parsed.logs
   674	            ]
   675	            + captured,
   676	        )
   677	    return parsed

   680	def _raise_requalified(
   681	    exc: RendererException,
   682	    *,
   683	    backend: str,
   684	    logs: Mapping[str, str],
   685	) -> None:
   686	    error = exc.error
   687	    details = dict(error.details)
   688	    if error.backend != backend:
   689	        details.setdefault("reported_backend", error.backend)
   690	    details.update(logs)
   691	    raise_structured_failure(
   692	        error.kind,
   693	        backend=backend,
   694	        message=error.message,
   695	        recovery_command=error.recovery_command,
   696	        details=details,
   697	    )

    97	def build_child_subprocess_env(
    98	    *,
    99	    base: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
   100	    parent: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
   101	    explicit_env: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
   102	    passthrough: Iterable[str] = (),
   103	    declared_passthrough: Iterable[str] = (),
   104	) -> dict[str, str]:
   105	    """Return the safe environment for an Astrid child process.
   106	
   107	    ``base`` contributes only known-safe process variables unless a key is
   108	    declared and requested through ``passthrough``. Astrid task/session/project
   109	    invariants are copied from ``parent`` and take precedence over ``base``.
   110	    """
   111	
   112	    base_env = os.environ if base is None else base
   113	    parent_env = os.environ if parent is None else parent
   114	    requested = _normalize_names(passthrough, "passthrough")
   115	    declared = _normalize_names(declared_passthrough, "declared_passthrough")
   116	    undeclared = requested - declared
   117	    if undeclared:
   118	        names = ", ".join(sorted(undeclared))
   119	        raise SubprocessEnvPolicyError(f"env passthrough requested without declaration: {names}")
   120	
   121	    env: dict[str, str] = {}
   122	    for key, value in base_env.items():
   123	        if key in _SAFE_BASE_ENV or key in requested:
   124	            if not _is_secret_name(key):
   125	                env[key] = str(value)
   126	
   127	    for key, value in (explicit_env or {}).items():
   128	        env[str(key)] = str(value)
   129	
   130	    env.pop(ASTRID_ACTOR, None)
   131	    for key in sorted(_ASTRID_PROPAGATED_ENV):
   132	        value = parent_env.get(key)
   133	        if value is not None:
   134	            env[key] = str(value)
   135	    return env
   136

   138	def _normalize_names(values: Iterable[str], label: str) -> set[str]:
   139	    names: set[str] = set()
   140	    for value in values:
   141	        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
   142	            raise SubprocessEnvPolicyError(f"{label} entries must be non-empty strings")
   143	        if not _ENV_NAME_RE.fullmatch(value):
   144	            raise SubprocessEnvPolicyError(f"{label} entry {value!r} is not a valid environment variable name")
   145	        if _is_secret_name(value):
   146	            raise SubprocessEnvPolicyError(f"{label} entry {value!r} looks secret-like")
   147	        names.add(value)
   148	    return names
   149

   152	    return bool(_SECRET_NAME_RE.search(name))

by two segment artifacts. After invocation, it verifies that the final video's
attachment map contains the unchanged union of all input attachments;
additional globally unique finalizer-created attachments are permitted.

Final assembly is explicit even when it is a one-segment pass-through.
Finalizers probe every input and compare it with the plan profile. Compatible
segments may stream-copy. Otherwise the finalizer normalizes dimensions,
rational FPS/time base, container, video codec/profile/level, pixel format,
audio codec/sample rate/channel layout, and audio presence. Every performed
normalization is appended to `normalization`. The finalizer preserves
attachments it does not understand. The first built-in finalizer uses FFmpeg;
its one canonical qualified ID is `rendering.ffmpeg-finalizer`. FFmpeg is not
part of the generic contract.

## Structured errors

A `RendererError` contains:

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `schema_version` | Required integer `1`. |
| `kind` | One of `protocol`, `unsupported`, `binary_missing`, `timeout`, `interrupted`, `invalid_artifact`, or `internal`. |
| `backend` | Qualified implementation ID; host validation uses `astrid.core`. |
| `message` | Non-empty actionable message. |
| `recovery_command` | Nullable concrete recovery command or action. |
| `details` | JSON-safe structured evidence. |

Unknown, missing, boolean, non-integer, or unsupported versions on requests,
support reports, plans, finalize requests, successful results, and error
results are always `kind="protocol"`. So are malformed request/result JSON and
missing authoritative results. Unsupported timelines use `unsupported`; a
missing manifest-declared executable uses `binary_missing`; deadline expiry
uses `timeout`; transport cancellation uses `interrupted`; missing, escaping,
empty, hash-mismatched, or media-incompatible outputs use
`invalid_artifact`; unexpected implementation bugs use `internal`.

The host cleans and reaps children before surfacing interruption. A real user
SIGINT/`KeyboardInterrupt` is then re-raised so normal exit-130 behavior is
preserved rather than converted into an unrelated exit-code layer.

    82	def _default_allowed_root(registry_path: Path) -> Path | None:
    83	    """Choose the narrowest useful root for user-declared local assets.

   125	def _hardlink_or_copy_checked(source: Path, destination: Path) -> None:
   126	    """Stage a validated local file without following a later symlink swap."""
   127	
   128	    flags = os.O_RDONLY
   129	    if hasattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW"):
   130	        flags |= os.O_NOFOLLOW
   131	    descriptor = os.open(source, flags)
   132	    try:
   133	        source_stat = os.fstat(descriptor)
   134	        if not stat.S_ISREG(source_stat.st_mode):
   135	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Asset is not a regular file: {source}")
   136	        try:
   137	            os.link(source, destination, follow_symlinks=False)
   138	            destination_stat = os.stat(destination, follow_symlinks=False)
   139	            if (
   140	                stat.S_ISREG(destination_stat.st_mode)
   141	                and destination_stat.st_dev == source_stat.st_dev
   142	                and destination_stat.st_ino == source_stat.st_ino
   143	            ):
   144	                return
   145	        except OSError:
   146	            pass
   147	        destination.unlink(missing_ok=True)
   148	        try:
   149	            with os.fdopen(os.dup(descriptor), "rb") as input_file, destination.open(
   150	                "xb"
   151	            ) as output_file:
   152	                shutil.copyfileobj(input_file, output_file, length=1024 * 1024)
   153	            os.chmod(destination, stat.S_IMODE(source_stat.st_mode))
   154	            with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
   155	                os.utime(
   156	                    destination,
   157	                    ns=(source_stat.st_atime_ns, source_stat.st_mtime_ns),
   158	                )
   159	        except BaseException:
   160	            destination.unlink(missing_ok=True)
   161	            raise
   162	    finally:
   163	        os.close(descriptor)

   348	    def _stage(

   492	_RANGE_RE = re.compile(r"^bytes=(\d*)-(\d*)$")

   494	
   495	class RangeHTTPRequestHandler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
   496	    """File-only HTTP handler with single-range byte serving."""
   497	
   498	    def log_message(self, format: str, *args: object) -> None:  # noqa: A002
   499	        return
   500	
   501	    def _send_416(self, size: int) -> None:
   502	        self.send_response(416, "Range Not Satisfiable")
   503	        self.send_header("Accept-Ranges", "bytes")
   504	        self.send_header("Content-Range", f"bytes */{size}")
   505	        self.send_header("Content-Length", "0")
   506	        self.end_headers()
   507	
   508	    def _resolved_file(self) -> Path | None:
   509	        root = Path(self.directory).resolve(strict=True)
   510	        translated = Path(self.translate_path(self.path))
   511	        try:
   512	            resolved = translated.resolve(strict=True)
   513	        except (FileNotFoundError, OSError):
   514	            self.send_error(404, "File not found")
   515	            return None
   516	        if not _contained(resolved, root) or not resolved.is_file():
   517	            self.send_error(404, "File not found")
   518	            return None
   519	        return resolved
   520	
   520	
   521	    @staticmethod
   522	    def _range_bounds(header: str, size: int) -> tuple[int, int] | None:
   523	        match = _RANGE_RE.fullmatch(header)
   524	        if match is None or size <= 0:
   525	            return None
   526	        start_text, end_text = match.groups()
   527	        if not start_text and not end_text:
   528	            return None
   529	        try:
   530	            if not start_text:
   531	                suffix_length = int(end_text)
   532	                if suffix_length <= 0:
   533	                    return None
   534	                return max(0, size - suffix_length), size - 1
   535	            start = int(start_text)
   536	            if start >= size:
   537	                return None
   538	            end = size - 1 if not end_text else min(int(end_text), size - 1)
   539	        except ValueError:
   540	            return None
   541	        if end < start:
   542	            return None
   543	        return start, end
   544	
   545	    def send_head(self):
   546	        path = self._resolved_file()
   547	        if path is None:
   548	            return None
   549	        try:
   550	            source = path.open("rb")
   551	        except OSError:
   552	            self.send_error(404, "File not found")
   553	            return None
   554	        try:
   555	            size = os.fstat(source.fileno()).st_size
   556	        except OSError:
   557	            source.close()
   558	            self.send_error(500, "File stat failed")
   559	            return None
   560	
   561	        range_header = self.headers.get("Range")
   562	        if range_header is not None:
   563	            bounds = self._range_bounds(range_header, size)
   564	            if bounds is None:
   565	                source.close()
   566	                self._send_416(size)
   567	                return None
   568	            start, end = bounds
   569	            length = end - start + 1
   570	            source.seek(start)
   571	            self._range_limit = length
   572	            self.send_response(206)
   573	            self.send_header("Content-Type", self.guess_type(str(path)))
   574	            self.send_header("Accept-Ranges", "bytes")
   575	            self.send_header("Content-Range", f"bytes {start}-{end}/{size}")
   576	            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(length))
   577	            self.end_headers()
   578	            return source
   579	
   580	        self._range_limit = None
   581	        self.send_response(200)
   582	        self.send_header("Content-Type", self.guess_type(str(path)))
   583	        self.send_header("Accept-Ranges", "bytes")
   584	        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(size))
   585	        self.end_headers()
   586	        return source
   587	
   588	    def copyfile(self, source: Any, outputfile: Any) -> None:
   589	        limit = getattr(self, "_range_limit", None)
   590	        if limit is None:
   591	            try:
   592	                super().copyfile(source, outputfile)
   593	            except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError):
   594	                pass
   595	            return
   596	        remaining = limit
   597	        try:
   598	            while remaining > 0:
   599	                chunk = source.read(min(64 * 1024, remaining))
   600	                if not chunk:
   601	                    break
   602	                outputfile.write(chunk)
   603	                remaining -= len(chunk)
   604	        except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError):
   605	            pass
   606	
   607	
   608	# Kept as a module-level alias because older cache/smoke tests subclassed the
   609	# handler through the render executor's private name.
   610	_RangeHTTPRequestHandler = RangeHTTPRequestHandler

   613	class InvocationAssetServer:
   614	    """Serve exactly one materializer staging directory over loopback HTTP."""
   615	
   616	    host = "127.0.0.1"
   617	    bind_port = 0
   618	
   619	    def __init__(self, staging_dir: str | Path) -> None:
   620	        self.staging_dir = Path(staging_dir).resolve(strict=True)
   621	        if not self.staging_dir.is_dir():
   622	            raise NotADirectoryError(f"Asset staging path is not a directory: {self.staging_dir}")
   623	        self._server: ThreadingHTTPServer | None = None
   624	        self.thread: threading.Thread | None = None
   625	        self._closed = False
   626	
   627	    @property
   628	    def port(self) -> int:
   629	        if self._server is None:
   630	            return 0
   631	        return int(self._server.server_address[1])
   632	
   633	    @property
   634	    def server_address(self) -> tuple[str, int]:
   635	        return (self.host, self.port)
   636	
   637	    @property
   638	    def base_url(self) -> str:
   639	        if self._server is None or self.port == 0:
   640	            raise RuntimeError("Invocation asset server has not been started")
   641	        return f"http://{self.host}:{self.port}"
   642	
   643	    def start(self) -> "InvocationAssetServer":
   644	        if self._closed:
   645	            raise RuntimeError("Invocation asset server is closed")
   646	        if self._server is not None:
   647	            return self
   648	        handler = partial(RangeHTTPRequestHandler, directory=str(self.staging_dir))
   649	        server = ThreadingHTTPServer((self.host, self.bind_port), handler)
   650	        try:
   651	            thread = threading.Thread(
   652	                target=server.serve_forever,
   653	                name=f"astrid-asset-server-{server.server_port}",
   654	                daemon=True,
   655	            )
   656	            self._server = server
   657	            self.thread = thread
   658	            thread.start()
   659	        except BaseException:
   660	            server.server_close()
   661	            self._server = None
   662	            self.thread = None
   663	            raise
   664	        return self
   665	
   666	    def local_url(self, staged_path: str | Path) -> str:
   667	        if self._server is None:
   668	            raise RuntimeError("Invocation asset server has not been started")
   669	        path = Path(staged_path).resolve(strict=True)
   670	        if not path.is_file() or not _contained(path, self.staging_dir):
   671	            raise ValueError(f"Asset path is outside the invocation staging directory: {path}")
   672	        relative = path.relative_to(self.staging_dir).as_posix()
   673	        return f"{self.base_url}/{urllib.parse.quote(relative, safe='/')}"
   674	
   675	    def local_urls(
   676	        self,
   677	        assets: Mapping[str, MaterializedAsset],
   678	    ) -> dict[str, str]:
   679	        return {
   680	            key: self.local_url(asset.local_path)
   681	            for key, asset in assets.items()
   682	            if asset.local_path is not None
   683	        }
   684	
   685	    def close(self) -> None:
   686	        if self._closed:
   687	            return
   688	        server = self._server
   689	        thread = self.thread
   690	        if server is None:
   691	            self._closed = True
   692	            return
   693	        cleanup_error: BaseException | None = None
   694	        try:
   695	            if thread is not None and thread.is_alive():
   696	                server.shutdown()
   697	        except BaseException as exc:
   698	            cleanup_error = exc
   699	        try:
   700	            server.server_close()
   701	        except BaseException as exc:
   702	            if cleanup_error is None:
   703	                cleanup_error = exc
   704	        try:
   705	            if thread is not None and thread is not threading.current_thread():
   706	                thread.join()
   707	        except BaseException as exc:
   708	            if cleanup_error is None:
   709	                cleanup_error = exc
   710	        if cleanup_error is not None:
   711	            raise cleanup_error
   712	        self._server = None
   713	        self._closed = True
   714	
   715	    def __enter__(self) -> "InvocationAssetServer":
   716	        return self.start()
   717	
   718	    def __exit__(self, exc_type: object, exc: object, tb: object) -> None:
   719	        self.close()
   720	
   721	
   722	__all__ = [
   723	    "AssetMaterializer",
   724	    "InvocationAssetServer",
   725	    "MaterializedAsset",
   726	    "RangeHTTPRequestHandler",
   727	]

     if not package_json.exists():
         raise FileNotFoundError(f"Remotion project is missing package.json: {package_json}")
     node_modules = project_dir / "node_modules"

             "Run `npm install` in tools/remotion/ first; "
             "see docs/reference/render-adapter.md for @banodoco adapter package install instructions"

     # These packages are adapter-installed (GitHub tarball), not published
     # to a public npm registry.  See docs/reference/render-adapter.md (SD2).

     _BANODOCO_REQUIRED = (
         "timeline-composition",
         "timeline-schema",
         "timeline-theme-2rp",
     )
     missing: list[str] = []
     for pkg in _BANODOCO_REQUIRED:
         pkg_dir = banodoco_root / pkg
         if not pkg_dir.is_dir():

 def _window_clip(clip: dict, start: float, end: float) -> dict | None:
     if not _clip_overlaps(clip, start, end):
         return None
     clip_start = float(clip.get("at", 0) or 0)
     visible_start = max(clip_start, start)
     visible_end = min(_clip_timeline_end_seconds(clip), end)
     if visible_end <= visible_start:
         return None
 
     out = dict(clip)
     out["at"] = visible_start - start
     out["id"] = f"{clip.get('id', 'clip')}_{start:.3f}_{end:.3f}".replace(".", "_")
     if clip.get("clipType") == "media":
         speed = float(clip.get("speed", 1) or 1)
         source_from = float(clip.get("from", 0) or 0) + ((visible_start - clip_start) * speed)
         out["from"] = source_from
         out["to"] = source_from + ((visible_end - visible_start) * speed)
     elif isinstance(clip.get("hold"), (int, float)):
         out["hold"] = visible_end - visible_start
     return out
 
 
 def _window_timeline_data(timeline_data: dict, start: float, end: float, *, media_only: bool) -> dict:
     clips: list[dict] = []
     for clip in timeline_data.get("clips", []):
         if media_only and clip.get("clipType") != "media":
             continue
         windowed = _window_clip(clip, start, end)
         if windowed is not None:
             clips.append(windowed)
     used_tracks = {clip.get("track") for clip in clips}
     tracks = [track for track in timeline_data.get("tracks", []) if track.get("id") in used_tracks]
     out = dict(timeline_data)
     out["tracks"] = tracks
     out["clips"] = clips
     out["metadata"] = {
         **dict(timeline_data.get("metadata", {})),
         "source_window_start_seconds": start,
         "source_window_end_seconds": end,
         "duration_seconds": end - start,
     }
     return out
 
 
 def _validate_ffmpeg_media_timeline(timeline_data: dict) -> None:
     tracks = {track.get("id"): track for track in timeline_data.get("tracks", [])}
     visual_tracks = [track for track in tracks.values() if track.get("kind") == "visual"]
     audio_tracks = [track for track in tracks.values() if track.get("kind") == "audio"]
     if len(visual_tracks) != 1:
         raise ValueError("ffmpeg engine supports exactly one visual track")
     for clip in timeline_data.get("clips", []):
         if clip.get("clipType") != "media":
             raise ValueError(f"ffmpeg engine only supports media clips, got {clip.get('clipType')!r}")
         if float(clip.get("speed", 1) or 1) != 1.0:
             raise ValueError("ffmpeg engine does not support speed changes yet")
         track = tracks.get(clip.get("track"), {})
         if track.get("kind") == "visual" and float(clip.get("volume", 0) or 0) != 0:
             raise ValueError("ffmpeg engine expects visual clips to have muted embedded audio")
     audio_track_ids = {track["id"] for track in audio_tracks}
     audio_clips = sorted(
         [clip for clip in timeline_data.get("clips", []) if clip.get("track") in audio_track_ids],
         key=lambda clip: float(clip.get("at", 0) or 0),
     )
     cursor = 0.0
     for clip in audio_clips:
         at = float(clip.get("at", 0) or 0)
         if at < cursor - 0.001:
             raise ValueError("ffmpeg engine supports multiple audio tracks only when audio clips do not overlap")
         cursor = max(cursor, at + _clip_duration_seconds(clip))

 def _complex_clip_windows(timeline_data: dict, fps: int, *, handle_seconds: float = 0.25) -> list[tuple[float, float]]:
     duration = _timeline_duration_seconds(timeline_data)
     tracks = {track.get("id"): track for track in timeline_data.get("tracks", [])}
     visual_track_ids = {track.get("id") for track in timeline_data.get("tracks", []) if track.get("kind") == "visual"}
     visual_media_coverage: dict[str, float] = {}
     for candidate in timeline_data.get("clips", []):
         if candidate.get("clipType") != "media" or candidate.get("track") not in visual_track_ids:
             continue
         track_id = str(candidate.get("track"))
         visual_media_coverage[track_id] = visual_media_coverage.get(track_id, 0.0) + _clip_duration_seconds(candidate)
     base_visual_track_id = max(visual_media_coverage, key=visual_media_coverage.get) if visual_media_coverage else None
     windows: list[tuple[float, float]] = []
     clips = timeline_data.get("clips", [])
     for index, clip in enumerate(clips):
         media_clip = clip.get("clipType") == "media"
         if media_clip:
             track = tracks.get(clip.get("track"), {})
             params = clip.get("params") if isinstance(clip.get("params"), dict) else {}
             effects = clip.get("effects")
             has_effects = bool(effects)
             has_transition = bool(clip.get("transition"))
             has_overlay_track = track.get("kind") == "visual" and clip.get("track") != base_visual_track_id
             has_opacity = isinstance(clip.get("opacity"), (int, float)) and float(clip.get("opacity") or 0) != 1.0
             has_audio_fade = track.get("kind") == "audio" and (
                 isinstance(params.get("fadeIn"), (int, float)) or isinstance(params.get("fadeOut"), (int, float))
             )
             if not (has_effects or has_transition or has_overlay_track or has_opacity or has_audio_fade):
                 continue
             next_same_track = next(
                 (candidate for candidate in clips[index + 1 :] if candidate.get("track") == clip.get("track")),
                 None,
             )
             if has_transition and next_same_track is not None:
                 transition = clip.get("transition")
                 transition_seconds = 8 / fps
                 if isinstance(transition, dict):
                     if isinstance(transition.get("duration"), (int, float)):
                         transition_seconds = float(transition["duration"])
                     elif isinstance(transition.get("durationFrames"), (int, float)):
                         transition_seconds = float(transition["durationFrames"]) / fps
                 clip_end = _clip_timeline_end_seconds(clip)
                 next_start = float(next_same_track.get("at", clip_end) or clip_end)
                 start = max(0.0, min(clip_end - transition_seconds, next_start) - handle_seconds)
                 end = min(duration, max(clip_end, next_start + transition_seconds) + handle_seconds)
                 if end > start:
                     windows.append(
                         (
                             _round_frame_time(start, fps, mode="floor"),
                             _round_frame_time(end, fps, mode="ceil"),
                         )
                     )
                 continue
         start = max(0.0, float(clip.get("at", 0) or 0) - handle_seconds)
         end = min(duration, _clip_timeline_end_seconds(clip) + handle_seconds)
         if end <= start:
             continue
         windows.append(
             (
                 _round_frame_time(start, fps, mode="floor"),
                 _round_frame_time(end, fps, mode="ceil"),
             )
         )

     for start, end in complex_windows:
         start = max(0.0, min(start, duration))
         end = max(start, min(end, duration))
         if start > cursor:
             segments.append({"engine": "ffmpeg", "from": cursor, "to": start})
         if end > start:
             segments.append({"engine": "remotion", "from": start, "to": end})
         cursor = max(cursor, end)
     if cursor < duration:
         segments.append({"engine": "ffmpeg", "from": cursor, "to": duration})
     return [segment for segment in segments if float(segment["to"]) > float(segment["from"])]

     filters.append("".join(concat_inputs) + f"concat=n={len(segment_paths)}:v=1:a=1[vout][aout]")

         [

 def _stderr_tail(stderr: str) -> str:
     lines = stderr.splitlines()
     tail = lines[-40:] if len(lines) > 40 else lines
     return "\n".join(tail).strip()
 
 
 def _require_free_space(path: Path, min_free_gb: float | None) -> None:
     if min_free_gb is None or min_free_gb <= 0:
         return
     target = path if path.exists() else path.parent
     usage = shutil.disk_usage(target)
     min_free = int(min_free_gb * 1024 * 1024 * 1024)
     if usage.free < min_free:
         free_gb = usage.free / (1024 * 1024 * 1024)
         raise RuntimeError(
             f"Remotion render needs at least {min_free_gb:.1f} GiB free at {target}; "
             f"only {free_gb:.1f} GiB is available"
         )
 
 
 def _parse_bool_arg(value: str | bool | None) -> bool:
     if value is None:
         return True
     if isinstance(value, bool):
         return value
     normalized = value.strip().lower()
     if normalized in {"1", "true", "yes", "y", "on"}:
         return True
     if normalized in {"0", "false", "no", "n", "off"}:
         return False
     raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(f"expected boolean value, got {value!r}")

+def render(
+    timeline_path: Path,

+    out_path: Path,
+    *,

+    project_dir: Path | None = None,
+    composition_id: str = "TimelineComposition",
+    theme_path: Path | None = None,
+    min_free_gb: float | None = None,
+    keep_previous_renders: bool = False,
+) -> Path:
+    """Render privately and publish one locked video-plus-sidecar pair."""
+
+    out_path = out_path.resolve()
+    previous_outputs = (
+        ()
+        if keep_previous_renders
+        else _previous_render_outputs_for_timeline(out_path, timeline_path)
+    )
+    publication_token = _PUBLICATION_PREVIOUS_OUTPUTS.set(previous_outputs)
+    try:
+        return _render_with_publication_context(
+            timeline_path,
+            assets_path,
+            out_path,
+            engine=engine,
+            project_dir=project_dir,
+            composition_id=composition_id,
+            theme_path=theme_path,
+            min_free_gb=min_free_gb,
+        )
+    finally:
+        _PUBLICATION_PREVIOUS_OUTPUTS.reset(publication_token)
 
 
 def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
     parser.add_argument("--timeline", type=Path, required=True)
     parser.add_argument("--assets", type=Path)
     parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
     parser.add_argument("--engine", choices=("remotion", "ffmpeg", "hybrid"), default="remotion")
     parser.add_argument("--project-dir", type=Path, default=REPO_ROOT / "remotion")
     parser.add_argument("--composition", default="TimelineComposition")
     parser.add_argument("--min-free-gb", type=float, default=None, help="Abort before rendering unless this much free disk is available near --out.")
     parser.add_argument(
         "--keep-previous-renders",
         nargs="?",
         const=True,
         default=False,
         type=_parse_bool_arg,
         help="Preserve previous sibling hype.mp4 outputs for the same timeline.",
     )
     parser.add_argument(
         "--theme",
         type=Path,
         default=REPO_ROOT / "themes" / "banodoco-default" / "theme.json",
     )
     args = parser.parse_args(argv)
     try:
         if args.assets is None:
             with TemporaryDirectory(prefix="astrid-render-assets-") as tmp_text:
                 assets_path = Path(tmp_text) / "hype.assets.json"
                 _write_empty_asset_registry(assets_path)
                 output = render(
                     args.timeline,
                     assets_path,
                     args.out,
                     engine=args.engine,
                     project_dir=args.project_dir,
                     composition_id=args.composition,
                     theme_path=args.theme,
                     min_free_gb=args.min_free_gb,
                     keep_previous_renders=args.keep_previous_renders,
                 )
         else:
             output = render(
                 args.timeline,
                 args.assets,
                 args.out,
                 engine=args.engine,
                 project_dir=args.project_dir,
                 composition_id=args.composition,
                 theme_path=args.theme,
                 min_free_gb=args.min_free_gb,
                 keep_previous_renders=args.keep_previous_renders,
             )
     except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - CLI path
         print(str(exc), file=sys.stderr)
         return 1
     print(output)
     return 0

 class RenderRemotionRegistryGenerationTest(unittest.TestCase):
     def _write_empty_render_inputs(self, tmp: Path) -> tuple[Path, Path, Path]:
         timeline_path = tmp / "hype.timeline.json"
         assets_path = tmp / "hype.assets.json"
         out_path = tmp / "hype.mp4"
         timeline.save_timeline(
             {
                 "theme": "banodoco-default",
                 "tracks": [{"id": "v1", "kind": "visual", "label": "Generated"}],
                 "clips": [],
             },
             timeline_path,
         )
         timeline.save_registry({"assets": {}}, assets_path)
         return timeline_path, assets_path, out_path
 
     def _write_fake_remotion_project(self, tmp: Path) -> tuple[Path, Path]:
         project_dir = tmp / "remotion"
         banodoco_root = project_dir / "node_modules" / "@banodoco"
         composition_src = banodoco_root / "timeline-composition" / "typescript" / "src"
         composition_src.mkdir(parents=True)
         # _validate_project_dir requires all three @banodoco adapter packages
         # (see docs/reference/render-adapter.md).  Create stub directories for the other two.
         (banodoco_root / "timeline-schema").mkdir(parents=True)
         (banodoco_root / "timeline-theme-2rp").mkdir(parents=True)
         (project_dir / "package.json").write_text('{"scripts":{}}\n', encoding="utf-8")
         return project_dir, composition_src
 
     def _write_effect_definition(self, tmp: Path, effect_id: str, asset_text: str) -> ElementDefinition:
         root = tmp / "effects" / effect_id
         asset_path = root / "assets" / "badge.txt"
         asset_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
         asset_path.write_text(asset_text, encoding="utf-8")
         (root / "component.tsx").write_text("export default function Effect() { return null; }\n", encoding="utf-8")
         (root / "element.yaml").write_text(
             f"schema_version: 1\nid: {effect_id}\nkind: effect\ndefaults: {{}}\nschema: {{}}\n",
             encoding="utf-8",
         )
         return ElementDefinition(
             id=effect_id,
             kind="effects",
             root=root,
             source="pack:test",
             editable=False,
             priority=50,
             component=root / "component.tsx",
             schema={},
             defaults={},
             metadata={},
             assets=(ElementAsset(name="badge", path=Path("assets/badge.txt")),),
         )
 
     def _copy_local_effect_smoke_project(self, tmp: Path) -> tuple[Path, Path, Path, Path]:
         project_root = tmp / "fixture-project"
         shutil.copytree(LOCAL_EFFECT_SMOKE_FIXTURE, project_root)
         project_dir, _composition_src = self._write_fake_remotion_project(tmp)
         return (
             project_root,
             project_dir,
             project_root / "hype.timeline.json",
             project_root / "hype.assets.json",
         )
 
     def test_registry_generation_sets_theme_and_composition_env(self) -> None:
         with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="render-registry-") as tmp_text:
             tmp = Path(tmp_text)
             project_dir, composition_src = self._write_fake_remotion_project(tmp)
             theme_path = tmp / "theme.json"
             theme_path.write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
             calls: list[tuple[list[str], dict[str, object]]] = []
 
             def fake_run(cmd, **kwargs):
                 calls.append(([str(part) for part in cmd], kwargs))
                 return subprocess.CompletedProcess(cmd, 0, stdout="", stderr="")
 
             with (
                 mock.patch.dict(render_remotion.os.environ, {"ASTRID_RENDER_UNDECLARED": "host"}, clear=True),
                 mock.patch.object(render_remotion.subprocess, "run", side_effect=fake_run),
             ):
                 render_remotion._regenerate_element_registries(project_dir, theme_path)
 
         self.assertEqual(len(calls), 1)
         cmd, kwargs = calls[0]
         self.assertEqual(cmd[0], sys.executable)
         self.assertEqual(Path(cmd[1]), ROOT / "scripts" / "gen_effect_registry.py")
         self.assertEqual(cmd[2:], ["--theme", str(theme_path)])
         self.assertEqual(kwargs["cwd"], str(ROOT))
         env = kwargs["env"]
         self.assertIsInstance(env, dict)
         self.assertEqual(env["ASTRID_TIMELINE_COMPOSITION_SRC"], str(composition_src))
         self.assertNotIn("ASTRID_RENDER_UNDECLARED", env)
         self.assertTrue(kwargs["capture_output"])
         self.assertTrue(kwargs["check"])
         self.assertTrue(kwargs["text"])
 
     def test_registry_generation_skips_when_state_and_outputs_are_current(self) -> None:
         with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="render-registry-cache-") as tmp_text:
             tmp = Path(tmp_text)
             project_dir, _composition_src = self._write_fake_remotion_project(tmp)
             state = render_remotion._effective_registry_state(None)
             render_remotion._write_registry_state(project_dir, state)
             for output_path in render_remotion._registry_output_paths(project_dir):

# Task T2.4 — Invocation-scoped asset materialization [HARD]

Worktree: `/Users/peteromalley/Documents/reigh-workspace/Astrid-oracle`.
You have `workspace-write` permissions. Python: `PYENV_VERSION=3.11.11`.

## Context

Batch 2 of "Pluggable Timeline Renderers". T2.1 (transport) and T2.3 (asset
cache) are done before you. The current render monolith
(`astrid/packs/rendering/executors/render/run.py`) has asset classification
(`_classify_assets`), a broad-root HTTP server (`_RangeHTTPRequestHandler`,
`_server_root_for`), and URL resolution. Your job: replace those with a
contained, invocation-scoped asset service. Exploration findings
(`.oracle/findings/07-serving-remotion-lifecycle.txt`) documented the current
risks: over-broad server root, TOCTOU port race, thread not joined, fixed
props/staging paths.

## Change

Add `astrid/core/rendering/assets.py`:

- `AssetMaterializer`:
  - classify each asset descriptor: local path, cached URL, or already-remote
    URL (reuse the cache primitives moved to `asset_cache.py` by T2.3);
  - materialize LOCAL copies into an invocation-scoped staging dir via
    hardlink-or-copy (fall back to copy when hardlink fails); remote/cached
    assets downloaded into the staging dir through the shared cache;
  - preserve already-remote URLs as-is (no download);
  - deterministic cleanup on success and failure (context manager or
    explicit `close()`).
- `InvocationAssetServer`:
  - serves ONLY the invocation staging dir from `127.0.0.1` on port `0`
    (bind-once via socket so no TOCTOU);
  - Range request support (single `bytes=` range → 206, invalid → 416);
  - CORS not needed (same-origin local) but must not be `*`;
  - always shuts down, closes, AND joins its thread (no leak);
  - produces per-asset `local_url` values for the render request.
- Replace in `astrid/packs/rendering/executors/render/run.py` (ONLY the
  asset-classification/serving parts — leave the render dispatch intact):
  `_classify_assets`, `_server_root_for`, `_pick_free_port`, and the inline
  handler, so renders use the new service with the same observable behavior
  for local files and URLs.
- Add `tests/core/rendering/test_assets.py`:
  - local path asset → staged copy + local_url serves correct bytes;
  - cached URL asset → staged + Range resume;
  - already-remote URL → preserved, no download;
  - cross-project/traversal paths rejected;
  - server binds to 127.0.0.1 on port 0 (assert port != 0, host is
    loopback);
  - Range: valid single range → 206 + Content-Range; invalid → 416;
  - server thread joined on close (no lingering threads);
  - cleanup removes staging dir on success AND failure;
  - concurrent renders get distinct staging dirs / URLs.

## Acceptance

- `pytest -q tests/core/rendering/test_assets.py` passes.
- `pytest -q tests/core/rendering` has no NEW failures.
- `pytest -q tests/test_url_pipeline_smoke.py tests/test_asset_cache.py` still
  passes (behavior preserved for existing paths).

Run ONLY those commands. Do NOT run the full suite, formatters, or linters.
Do NOT touch `contracts.py`, `schemas/`, `docs/contracts/`, `transport.py`
(T2.1), or `asset_cache.py` (T2.3) — reuse them. Preserve all existing work.
Report: files changed, test results, the serving design.

# Task T2.5 — Resolve profiles and validate artifacts [HARD]

Worktree: `/Users/peteromalley/Documents/reigh-workspace/Astrid-oracle`.
You have `workspace-write` permissions. Python: `PYENV_VERSION=3.11.11`.

## Context

Batch 2 of "Pluggable Timeline Renderers". The frozen contracts
(`astrid/core/rendering/contracts.py`) define `RenderProfile` (dimensions,
rational FPS/time base, codecs, pixel format, audio rate/layout, duration
tolerance), `VideoArtifact`, `Attachment`, `AudioOwnership`. The finalizer
(Batch 3) and service (Batch 4) will consume these. Your job:
`resolve_render_profile` (canonical profile from the merged theme/timeline
canvas) and `validate_render_result` (strict artifact validation before
finalization).

## Change

1. `astrid/core/rendering/profile.py`:
   - `resolve_render_profile(timeline, assets, theme...)` — resolve the
     canonical profile from the merged theme/timeline canvas (width, height,
     rational FPS, time base, codecs, pixel format, audio rate/layout,
     duration tolerance). Read how the render monolith derives canvas today
     (run.py theme resolution + timeline model; see also
     `.oracle/findings/05-hybrid-planner-canvas.txt`) and how Remotion gets
     it (merged theme). The profile MUST match what Remotion renders.
   - Rational FPS as `(num, den)` — no float drift.
2. Extend `astrid/core/media.py` probing (add fields if missing): codec,
   pixel format, time base, audio codec/sample rate/channel layout, duration,
   FPS, dimensions. Keep existing callers working.
3. `astrid/core/rendering/artifacts.py`:
   - `validate_render_result(result, *, expected_profile, workspace_root)`:
     reject missing/empty output, escaped paths (traversal, absolute,
     symlink escape), hash mismatch (recompute sha256 vs declared),
     profile-incompatible outputs (wrong dimensions/FPS/codecs/audio),
     duration-invalid (outside tolerance), audio-ownership-invalid (declared
     `rendered` but no audio stream; declared `none` but has audio —
     use the strict probe), invalid attachment paths/kinds/hashes.
   - PRESERVE valid named attachments (they pass through untouched).
   - Return structured `RendererError`s (use the frozen error kinds) with
     recovery guidance.
4. Add `tests/core/rendering/test_profile.py` and
   `tests/core/rendering/test_artifacts.py` covering every rejection case
   above plus the happy path. Extend `tests/core/util/test_media.py` for the
   new probe fields (or add `tests/core/rendering/test_media_probe.py`).

## Acceptance

- `pytest -q tests/core/rendering/test_profile.py tests/core/rendering/test_artifacts.py tests/core/util/test_media.py` passes (or your media test file).
- `pytest -q tests/core/rendering` has no NEW failures.
- Existing media.py consumers (`tests/core/util/test_media.py`, cut probe
  tests) still pass.

Run ONLY those commands. Do NOT run the full suite, formatters, or linters.
Do NOT touch `contracts.py`, `schemas/`, `docs/contracts/`, `transport.py`,
`assets.py` (T2.4), or `asset_cache.py` (T2.3). Preserve all existing work.
Report: files changed, test results, the probe fields added.

def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--baseline", type=Path, default=BASELINE_PATH)
    parser.add_argument("--write-baseline", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    current = _run()
    if args.write_baseline:
        args.baseline.write_text(json.dumps(current, indent=2) + "\n")
        print(f"Wrote Ruff baseline to {args.baseline} ({current['finding_count']} findings)")
        return 0

    baseline = json.loads(args.baseline.read_text())
    baseline_count = int(baseline["finding_count"])
    current_count = int(current["finding_count"])
    print(f"Ruff findings: current={current_count} baseline={baseline_count}")
    if current_count <= baseline_count:
        return 0
    return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

   149	    _ue(w, 0)               # seq_parameter_set_id
   150	    w.put(0, 1)             # entropy_coding_mode_flag (CAVLC)
   151	    w.put(0, 1)             # bottom_field_pic_order_in_frame_present_flag
   152	    _ue(w, 0)               # num_slice_groups_minus1
   153	    _ue(w, 0)               # num_ref_idx_l0_default_active_minus1
   154	    _ue(w, 0)               # num_ref_idx_l1_default_active_minus1
   155	    w.put(0, 1)             # weighted_pred_flag
   156	    w.put(0, 2)             # weighted_bipred_idc
   157	    _se(w, 0)               # pic_init_qp_minus26
   158	    _se(w, 0)               # pic_init_qs_minus26
   159	    _se(w, 0)               # chroma_qp_index_offset
   160	    w.put(0, 1)             # deblocking_filter_control_present_flag
   161	    w.put(0, 1)             # constrained_intra_pred_flag
   162	    w.put(0, 1)             # redundant_pic_cnt_present_flag
   163	    w.finish()
   164	    return bytes([0x68]) + _escape_rbsp(bytes(w.data))
   165	
   166	
   167	def _idr_slice_nal(frame_index: int) -> bytes:
   168	    """One IDR I-frame: every macroblock is I_16x16_2_0_0 with no residual.
   169	
   170	    With CodedBlockPatternLuma/Chroma = 0 the decoder reconstructs each 16x16
   171	    block from DC prediction (unavailable neighbours default to 128), so the
   172	    whole frame decodes to a deterministic solid color.  Six bits per MB:
   173	    mb_type ue(3) == "00100" (I_16x16 with Intra16x16PredMode 2 = DC) plus
   174	    intra_chroma_pred_mode ue(0) == "1" (chroma DC).
   175	    """
   176	    w = _BitWriter()
   177	    _ue(w, 0)               # first_mb_in_slice
   178	    _ue(w, 2)               # slice_type = I (2)
   179	    _ue(w, 0)               # pic_parameter_set_id
   180	    w.put(0, 4)             # frame_num (IDR pictures use 0)
   181	    _ue(w, 0)               # idr_pic_id
   182	    w.put((2 * frame_index) & 0xFF, 8)  # pic_order_cnt_lsb (POC grows by 2/frame)
   183	    w.put(0, 1)             # no_output_of_prior_pics_flag
   184	    w.put(0, 1)             # long_term_reference_flag
   185	    _se(w, 0)               # slice_qp_delta
   186	    for _ in range(_MB_COUNT):
   187	        w.put(0b001001, 6)  # mb_type=3 (I_16x16_2_0_0) + intra_chroma_pred_mode=0
   188	    w.finish()
   189	    return bytes([0x65]) + _escape_rbsp(bytes(w.data))
   190	
   191	
   192	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   193	# Minimal ISO BMFF (MP4) muxer
   194	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   195	
   196	
   197	def _box(box_type: bytes, payload: bytes) -> bytes:
   198	    return struct.pack(">I4s", 8 + len(payload), box_type) + payload
   199	
   200	
   201	def _fullbox(box_type: bytes, version_flags: int, payload: bytes) -> bytes:
   202	    return struct.pack(">I4sI", 12 + len(payload), box_type, version_flags) + payload
   203	
   204	
   205	def _matrix() -> bytes:
   206	    return _MATRIX
   207	
   208	
   209	def _ftyp() -> bytes:
   210	    return (
   211	        struct.pack(">I4sII", 32, b"ftyp", 0x69736F6D, 0x00000200)
   212	        + b"isomiso2avc1mp41"
   213	    )
   214	
   215	
   216	def _mvhd(duration: int) -> bytes:
   217	    payload = (
   218	        struct.pack(">IIII", 0, 0, 12288, duration)  # timescale = 12288
   219	        + struct.pack(">I", 0x00010000)              # rate 1.0
   220	        + struct.pack(">H", 0x0100)                  # volume 1.0
   220	        + struct.pack(">H", 0x0100)                  # volume 1.0
   221	        + struct.pack(">H", 0)
   222	        + struct.pack(">II", 0, 0)
   223	        + _matrix()
   224	        + b"\x00" * 24
   225	        + struct.pack(">I", 3)                       # next_track_ID
   226	    )
   227	    return _fullbox(b"mvhd", 0, payload)
   228	
   229	
   230	def _tkhd(track_id: int, duration: int, volume: int, width: int, height: int) -> bytes:
   231	    payload = (
   232	        struct.pack(">II", 0, 0)
   233	        + struct.pack(">I", track_id)
   234	        + struct.pack(">I", 0)
   235	        + struct.pack(">I", duration)
   236	        + struct.pack(">II", 0, 0)
   237	        + struct.pack(">Hh", 0, 0)
   238	        + struct.pack(">H", volume)
   239	        + struct.pack(">H", 0)
   240	        + _matrix()
   241	        + struct.pack(">II", width << 16, height << 16)
   242	    )
   243	    return _fullbox(b"tkhd", 0x00000007, payload)
   244	
   245	
   246	def _mdhd(timescale: int, duration: int) -> bytes:
   247	    payload = (
   248	        struct.pack(">IIII", 0, 0, timescale, duration)
   249	        + struct.pack(">HH", 0x55C4, 0)  # language "und"
   250	    )
   251	    return _fullbox(b"mdhd", 0, payload)
   252	
   253	
   254	def _hdlr(handler: bytes, name: bytes) -> bytes:
   255	    payload = struct.pack(">I", 0) + handler + b"\x00" * 12 + name + b"\x00"
   256	    return _fullbox(b"hdlr", 0, payload)
   257	
   258	
   259	def _dinf() -> bytes:
   260	    dref = _fullbox(b"dref", 0, struct.pack(">I", 1) + _fullbox(b"url ", 1, b""))
   261	    return _box(b"dinf", dref)
   262	
   263	
   264	def _avc1_entry(sps: bytes, pps: bytes) -> bytes:
   265	    avcc = (
   266	        bytes([1, 66, 0xC0, 40, 0xFF, 0xE1])
   267	        + struct.pack(">H", len(sps))
   268	        + sps
   269	        + bytes([1])
   270	        + struct.pack(">H", len(pps))
   271	        + pps
   272	    )
   273	    visual = (
   274	        b"\x00" * 6
   275	        + struct.pack(">H", 1)             # data_reference_index
   276	        + struct.pack(">HH", 0, 0)
   277	        + b"\x00" * 12
   278	        + struct.pack(">HH", WIDTH, HEIGHT)
   279	        + struct.pack(">II", 0x00480000, 0x00480000)  # 72 dpi
   280	        + struct.pack(">I", 0)
   281	        + struct.pack(">H", 1)             # frame_count
   282	        + b"RawCommand\x00" + b"\x00" * 21  # compressorname (32 bytes)
   283	        + struct.pack(">Hh", 24, -1)       # depth 24, pre_defined -1
   284	    )
   285	    return _box(b"avc1", visual + _box(b"avcC", avcc))
   286	
   287	
   288	def _sowt_entry() -> bytes:
   289	    wave = _box(
   290	        b"wave",
   291	        _box(b"frma", b"sowt") + _box(b"enda", struct.pack(">H", 1)),
   292	    )
   293	    audio = (
   294	        b"\x00" * 6
   295	        + struct.pack(">H", 1)             # data_reference_index
   296	        + struct.pack(">HH", 0, 0)
   297	        + struct.pack(">I", 0)             # vendor
   298	        + struct.pack(">HH", AUDIO_CHANNELS, AUDIO_BITS)
   299	        + struct.pack(">HH", 0, 0)         # compressionid, packetsize
   300	        + struct.pack(">I", AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE << 16)
   301	    )
   302	    return _box(b"sowt", audio + wave)
   303	
   304	
   305	def _sample_tables(
   306	    *,
   307	    video_frames: int,
   308	    video_sizes: list[int],
   309	    video_chunk_offset: int,
   310	    audio_bytes: bytes,
   311	    audio_samples: int,
   312	    audio_chunk_offset: int,
   313	) -> bytes:
   314	    stsd_v = _fullbox(b"stsd", 0, struct.pack(">I", 1) + _avc1_entry(_sps_nal(), _pps_nal()))
   315	    stts_v = _fullbox(
   316	        b"stts", 0, struct.pack(">I", 1) + struct.pack(">II", video_frames, SAMPLES_PER_FRAME)
   317	    )
   318	    stsc_v = _fullbox(
   319	        b"stsc", 0, struct.pack(">I", 1) + struct.pack(">III", 1, video_frames, 1)
   320	    )
   321	    stsz_v = _fullbox(
   322	        b"stsz", 0, struct.pack(">II", 0, video_frames)
   323	        + b"".join(struct.pack(">I", size) for size in video_sizes)
   324	    )
   325	    stco_v = _fullbox(b"stco", 0, struct.pack(">I", 1) + struct.pack(">I", video_chunk_offset))
   326	
   327	    stsd_a = _fullbox(b"stsd", 0, struct.pack(">I", 1) + _sowt_entry())
   328	    stts_a = _fullbox(
   329	        b"stts", 0, struct.pack(">I", 1) + struct.pack(">II", 1, audio_samples)
   330	    )
   331	    stsc_a = _fullbox(b"stsc", 0, struct.pack(">I", 1) + struct.pack(">III", 1, 1, 1))
   332	    stsz_a = _fullbox(
   333	        b"stsz", 0, struct.pack(">II", 0, 1) + struct.pack(">I", len(audio_bytes))
   334	    )
   335	    stco_a = _fullbox(b"stco", 0, struct.pack(">I", 1) + struct.pack(">I", audio_chunk_offset))
   336	
   337	    video_stbl = _box(b"stbl", stsd_v + stts_v + stsc_v + stsz_v + stco_v)
   338	    audio_stbl = _box(b"stbl", stsd_a + stts_a + stsc_a + stsz_a + stco_a)
   339	    return video_stbl, audio_stbl
   340	
   341	
   342	def _build_mp4(frames: int) -> bytes:
   343	    """Return a deterministic MP4: `frames` H.264 IDR frames + PCM silence."""
   344	    video_chunk = bytearray()
   345	    video_sizes: list[int] = []
   346	    for frame_index in range(frames):
   347	        nal = _idr_slice_nal(frame_index)
   348	        sample = struct.pack(">I", len(nal)) + nal
   349	        video_chunk += sample
   350	        video_sizes.append(len(sample))
   351	    video_chunk = bytes(video_chunk)
   352	
   353	    audio_samples = frames * (AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE // FPS_RATIONAL[0])
   354	    audio_bytes = b"\x00" * (audio_samples * AUDIO_CHANNELS * (AUDIO_BITS // 8))
   355	
   356	    ftyp = _ftyp()
   357	    video_chunk_offset = len(ftyp) + 8
   358	    audio_chunk_offset = video_chunk_offset + len(video_chunk)
   359	
   360	    video_stbl, audio_stbl = _sample_tables(
   361	        video_frames=frames,
   362	        video_sizes=video_sizes,
   363	        video_chunk_offset=video_chunk_offset,
   364	        audio_bytes=audio_bytes,
   365	        audio_samples=audio_samples,
   366	        audio_chunk_offset=audio_chunk_offset,
   367	    )
   368	
   369	    vmhd = _fullbox(b"vmhd", 1, struct.pack(">H", 0) + b"\x00" * 6)
   370	    smhd = _fullbox(b"smhd", 0, struct.pack(">HH", 0, 0))
   371	    dinf = _dinf()
   372	
   373	    minf_v = _box(b"minf", vmhd + dinf + video_stbl)
   374	    mdia_v = _box(b"mdia", _mdhd(12288, frames * SAMPLES_PER_FRAME) + _hdlr(b"vide", b"VideoHandler") + minf_v)
   375	    trak_v = _box(b"trak", _tkhd(1, frames * SAMPLES_PER_FRAME, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT) + mdia_v)
   376	
   377	    minf_a = _box(b"minf", smhd + dinf + audio_stbl)
   378	    mdia_a = _box(b"mdia", _mdhd(AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE, audio_samples) + _hdlr(b"soun", b"SoundHandler") + minf_a)
   379	    trak_a = _box(b"trak", _tkhd(2, audio_samples, 0x0100, 0, 0) + mdia_a)
   380	
   381	    moov = _box(b"moov", _mvhd(frames * SAMPLES_PER_FRAME) + trak_v + trak_a)
   382	    mdat = _box(b"mdat", video_chunk + audio_bytes)
   383	    return ftyp + mdat + moov
   384	
   385

   387	# Protocol verbs
   388	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

   390	
   391	def _write_json(path: Path, payload: dict) -> None:
   392	    path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
   393	
   394	
   395	def _write_error(result_path: Path, kind: str, message: str, details: dict) -> None:
   396	    _write_json(
   397	        result_path,
   398	        {
   399	            "schema_version": 1,
   400	            "kind": kind,
   401	            "backend": BACKEND_ID,
   402	            "message": message,
   403	            "recovery_command": None,
   404	            "details": details,
   405	        },
   406	    )
   407	
   408	
   409	def _validate_request(request: dict) -> None:
   410	    if request.get("schema_version") != 1:
   411	        raise ValueError(
   412	            f"unsupported request schema_version {request.get('schema_version')!r}; expected 1"
   413	        )
   414	    output_name = request.get("output_name")
   415	    if not isinstance(output_name, str) or output_name in (".", ".."):
   416	        raise ValueError("output_name must be a non-empty portable basename")
   417	    if not _OUTPUT_NAME_RE.fullmatch(output_name):
   418	        raise ValueError("output_name must match [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*")
   419	    window = request.get("window")
   420	    if window is not None and not isinstance(window, dict):
   421	        raise ValueError("window must be an object or null")
   422	    if isinstance(window, dict):
   423	        end = window.get("end_frame")
   424	        start = window.get("start_frame", 0)
   425	        if not isinstance(end, int) or not isinstance(start, int) or end <= start:
   426	            raise ValueError("window must satisfy 0 <= start_frame < end_frame")
   427	
   428	
   429	def _support(result_path: Path) -> int:
   430	    _write_json(
   431	        result_path,
   432	        {
   433	            "schema_version": 1,
   434	            "supported": True,
   435	            "reasons": [],
   436	            "features": {"media": True, "audio_mode": "rendered"},
   437	            "alternatives": [],
   438	            "backend": BACKEND_ID,
   439	            "backend_version": BACKEND_VERSION,
   440	        },
   441	    )
   442	    return 0
   443	
   444	
   445	def _render(request: dict, result_path: Path, request_path: Path) -> int:
   446	    try:
   447	        _validate_request(request)
   448	        window = request.get("window")
   449	        profile = request.get("profile") or {}
   450	        if isinstance(window, dict):
   451	            start = int(window.get("start_frame", 0))
   452	            end = int(window["end_frame"])
   453	        else:
   454	            start, end = 0, 48
   455	        frames = end - start
   456	        if frames <= 0:
   457	            raise ValueError("window must span at least one frame")
   458	
   459	        output_name = request["output_name"]
   460	        # The invocation workspace is the directory holding the request file;
   460	        # The invocation workspace is the directory holding the request file;
   461	        # keep every generated artifact contained there.
   462	        workspace = request_path.resolve().parent
   463	        out_dir = workspace / "outputs"
   464	        out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   465	        video_rel = f"outputs/{output_name}"
   466	        video_path = out_dir / output_name
   467	
   468	        media = _build_mp4(frames)
   469	        video_path.write_bytes(media)
   470	
   471	        probed_profile = {
   472	            "width": WIDTH,
   473	            "height": HEIGHT,
   474	            "fps_rational": list(FPS_RATIONAL),
   475	            "time_base": list(TIME_BASE),
   476	            "container": CONTAINER,
   477	            "video_codec": VIDEO_CODEC,
   478	            "video_profile": None,
   479	            "video_level": None,
   480	            "pixel_format": PIXEL_FORMAT,
   481	            "audio_codec": AUDIO_CODEC,
   482	            "audio_sample_rate": AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE,
   483	            "audio_channel_layout": AUDIO_CHANNEL_LAYOUT,
   484	            "duration_tolerance": int(profile.get("duration_tolerance", 1)),
   485	        }
   486	        result = {
   487	            "schema_version": 1,
   488	            "video": {
   489	                "path": video_rel,
   490	                "profile": probed_profile,
   491	                "sha256": hashlib.sha256(media).hexdigest(),
   492	                "duration_frames": frames,
   493	                "audio": "rendered",
   494	                "attachments": {},
   495	            },
   496	            "backend_fragments": {
   497	                BACKEND_ID: {
   498	                    "renderer": "raw_command",
   499	                    "media": "generated",
   500	                    "audio_mode": "rendered",
   501	                    "deterministic": True,
   502	                }
   503	            },
   504	            "audio_ownership": "rendered",
   505	            "normalization": [],
   506	            "logs": [],
   507	            "metadata": {},
   508	        }
   509	        _write_json(result_path, result)
   510	        return 0
   511	    except ValueError as exc:
   512	        _write_error(result_path, "protocol", str(exc), {"error_type": "ValueError"})
   513	        return 0
   514	    except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - unexpected failure path
   515	        _write_error(
   516	            result_path,
   517	            "internal",
   518	            f"raw_command renderer failed: {exc}",
   519	            {"error_type": type(exc).__name__},
   520	        )
   521	        return 0
   522	
   523	
   524	def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
   525	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
   526	        prog="backend.py",
   527	        description="Raw v1 rendering protocol fixture backend (no Astrid SDK).",
   528	    )
   529	    parser.add_argument("verb", choices=("render", "support", "plan", "finalize"))
   530	    parser.add_argument("--request", required=True, help="absolute path to request JSON")
   531	    parser.add_argument("--result", required=True, help="absolute path to result JSON")
   532	    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
   533	
   534	    request_path = Path(args.request)
   535	    result_path = Path(args.result)
   536	    try:
   537	        request = json.loads(request_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
   538	    except Exception as exc:
   539	        _write_error(
   540	            result_path,
   541	            "protocol",
   542	            f"cannot read request JSON from {request_path}: {exc}",
   543	            {"error_type": type(exc).__name__},
   544	        )
   545	        return 0
   546	
   547	    if args.verb == "support":
   548	        return _support(result_path)
   549	    if args.verb in ("plan", "finalize"):
   550	        _write_error(
   551	            result_path,
   552	            "unsupported",
   553	            f"{BACKEND_ID} only implements render and support",
   554	            {"verb": args.verb},
   555	        )
   556	        return 0
   557	    return _render(request, result_path, request_path)
   558	
   559	
   560	if __name__ == "__main__":
   561	    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

id: raw_command
name: Raw Command Fixture Pack
version: 1.0.0
description: >-
  Committed raw-command renderer fixture for the frozen v1 wire protocol
  (render-backend-v1.md). backend.py is a plain stdlib script that parses
  argv, reads --request JSON, and writes --result JSON. It never imports the
  Astrid SDK and never touches the Astrid ledger (no run.json).

  - id: subprocess

  - id: project_files
    reason: Read the invocation request JSON and write the generated video into the request workspace.
aliases:
  - kind: renderer
    alias: raw_command.legacy
    canonical_id: raw_command.renderer
extensions:
  rendering:
    renderers:
      - renderer.yaml

.oracle/findings/09-parity-fixtures-tests-ci.txt-1-## Ranked findings
.oracle/findings/09-parity-fixtures-tests-ci.txt-2-
.oracle/findings/09-parity-fixtures-tests-ci.txt:3:**1. Parity gate exists but is a hash-of-input, not a render** — `tests/packs/test_renderer_parity.py` is opt-in via `ASTRID_RENDERER_PARITY=1` (:24, :58–59). When enabled it runs `scripts/node/export_fixtures.mjs --json` (:34–42), asserts fixtures exist (:63–67), asserts no pending goldens (:69–74), then SHA-256s the **input JSON** canonically (:49–51, :79–85). Nothing renders. Golden hashes come from `tests/fixtures/sprint08/golden/<name>.sha256` read by the mjs (:50–54). The brief is confirmed: it hashes input JSON and renders nothing. `tests/fixtures/sprint08/` contains **only README.md** — zero fixtures, zero goldens.
.oracle/findings/09-parity-fixtures-tests-ci.txt-4-
.oracle/findings/09-parity-fixtures-tests-ci.txt:5:**2. Hype goldens exercise private helpers with fake media** — `tests/golden/hype/merged_render_props.json` + `hype.assets.json` are compared (sorted-JSON string equality) in `tests/packs/hype/test_hype_e2e.py:1040–1138`, which writes `b"fake-mp4"` placeholders (:1064–1065) and imports `_resolved_theme_for_render`/`_serialize_timeline` (:1093–1096) under `ASTRID_INTERNAL_INVOCATION=1`. `tests/fixtures/reshape/hype_regression/` mp4s are declared `omitted_from_git` with null sha256 (`media_manifest.json:22–39`); `test_hype_regression_fixture.py:34–39` regenerates them via ffmpeg or skips. **No committed real media exists.**
.oracle/findings/09-parity-fixtures-tests-ci.txt-6-
.oracle/findings/09-parity-fixtures-tests-ci.txt-7-**3. Private-symbol coupling** — `_RangeHTTPRequestHandler` (render.run) in `test_url_pipeline_smoke.py:17`, `test_asset_cache.py:19`; `run`/`audio_reactive_colour` modules in `test_text_card_render.py:9`, `test_render_remotion_registry.py:16`, `test_audio_reactive_colour.py:12–13`, `test_audio_render.py:7`; asset_cache privates `_read_meta/_write_meta/_meta_path/_lock_for` in `test_asset_cache.py:103,137,182–197,235`. `test_audio_reactive_colour.py` is the only real render test (ffmpeg pixel/stream asserts, :164–237).
.oracle/findings/09-parity-fixtures-tests-ci.txt-8-
.oracle/findings/09-parity-fixtures-tests-ci.txt-9-**4. CI lanes** — `ci.yml`: ffmpeg installed (:32–35); real render only inside pytest; Remotion typecheck blocking (:83–89); advisory `continue-on-error` steps (:49–51, :59–61). No job sets `ASTRID_RENDERER_PARITY`. `Makefile` `check` (:19), `ci` (:43) — no parity target. Markers registered in `pyproject.toml:154–165`.
.oracle/findings/09-parity-fixtures-tests-ci.txt-10-
.oracle/findings/09-parity-fixtures-tests-ci.txt-11-**5. Skip convention** — `pytest.importorskip("jsonschema")` (`test_audit.py:68`), module `skipif` (`test_platform_contract.py:17–20`), `pytest.skip("...opt-in; set ASTRID_RENDERER_PARITY=1")` (`test_renderer_parity.py:59`).
.oracle/findings/09-parity-fixtures-tests-ci.txt-12-
.oracle/findings/09-parity-fixtures-tests-ci.txt-13-## Verified facts
.oracle/findings/09-parity-fixtures-tests-ci.txt-14-- Parity test never invokes ffmpeg/remotion; asserts only JSON hashes.
.oracle/findings/09-parity-fixtures-tests-ci.txt:15:- sprint08 has README only; `export_fixtures.mjs` exists and reads `golden/*.sha256`.
.oracle/findings/09-parity-fixtures-tests-ci.txt-16-- Hype e2e golden test uses fake bytes, not media.
.oracle/findings/09-parity-fixtures-tests-ci.txt-17-
.oracle/findings/09-parity-fixtures-tests-ci.txt-18-## Unknowns
.oracle/findings/09-parity-fixtures-tests-ci.txt-19-- Whether the local mp4s are git-tracked (manifest says omit; `.gitignore:54,61–63` would track them).
.oracle/findings/09-parity-fixtures-tests-ci.txt-20-- Where reigh-app's `testing.ts` lives.
.oracle/findings/09-parity-fixtures-tests-ci.txt-21-
.oracle/findings/09-parity-fixtures-tests-ci.txt-22-## Risks
.oracle/findings/09-parity-fixtures-tests-ci.txt:23:- A "parity" gate that exercises nothing: helper-regenerated fixtures + goldens stay green while rendering breaks.
.oracle/findings/09-parity-fixtures-tests-ci.txt-24-- Default lane silently skips (no env var set anywhere).
.oracle/findings/09-parity-fixtures-tests-ci.txt-25-
.oracle/findings/09-parity-fixtures-tests-ci.txt-26-## Suggested approach
.oracle/findings/09-parity-fixtures-tests-ci.txt-27-Commit real sprint08 JSON + `golden/*.sha256`; extend parity to render headlessly (remotion) and hash output frames (ffmpeg `framemd5`); add `ASTRID_RENDERER_PARITY=1` to a new CI job after Remotion typecheck; add a `make parity` target; keep skip messages matching the existing opt-in wording.
--
.oracle/findings/02-schema-registry.txt-19-- Adding renderer requires touching 6+ coupled places (schema, PACK_ALIAS_KINDS, loader, alias extractor, new registry, CLI); missing any one = silent divergence.
.oracle/findings/02-schema-registry.txt-20-- Override omission means renderer overrides would be inert outside CLI unless default factories accept the store.
.oracle/findings/02-schema-registry.txt-21-- `additionalProperties:false` + `_filter_dynamic_element_kind_errors` show validation is schema-strict but patchy.
.oracle/findings/02-schema-registry.txt-22-
.oracle/findings/02-schema-registry.txt-23-## Suggested approach
.oracle/findings/02-schema-registry.txt:24:Subclass `CapabilityRegistry` for renderer reusing alias/override plumbing, add `renderer` to `PACK_ALIAS_KINDS` + pack.json enums/content keys in one commit, and fix the root cause by having `load_default_registry()` accept/construct `OverrideStore` instead of CLI-side patching. Add a sync test asserting schema and `permissions.py` reject/accept identical fixtures.
--

    51	class EphemeralSession:
    52	    """Tracks URL downloads minted during this session and deletes them on exit.
    53	
    54	    Files that already existed in the cache when fetch() was called are NOT
    55	    registered for deletion — only files this session minted (new download or
    56	    force-refetch). Sessions can be nested; the innermost active session owns
    57	    each new download.
    58	    """
    59	
    60	    def __init__(self, enabled: bool = True) -> None:
    61	        self.enabled = enabled
    62	        self._paths: set[Path] = set()
    63	
    64	    def register(self, path: Path) -> None:
    65	        if self.enabled:
    66	            self._paths.add(Path(path))
    67	
    68	    def __enter__(self) -> "EphemeralSession":
    69	        if self.enabled:
    70	            _SESSION_STACK.append(self)
    71	        return self
    72	
    73	    def __exit__(self, exc_type: object, exc: object, tb: object) -> None:
    74	        if not self.enabled:
    75	            return
    76	        try:
    77	            _SESSION_STACK.remove(self)
    78	        except ValueError:
    79	            pass
    80	        for path in sorted(self._paths):
    81	            self._cleanup(path)
    82	
    83	    def _cleanup(self, path: Path) -> None:
    84	        if path.suffix in {".partial", ".lock"}:
    85	            return
    86	        if _is_locked(path):
    87	            print(f"warning: skipping locked ephemeral cache entry {path}", file=sys.stderr)
    88	            return
    89	        meta_path = _meta_path(path)
    90	        for candidate in (path, meta_path):
    91	            try:
    92	                candidate.unlink()
    93	            except FileNotFoundError:
    94	                continue
    95	            except OSError as exc:
    96	                print(f"warning: failed to delete ephemeral cache entry {candidate}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
    97

   111	def _register_with_session(path: Path, *, preexisted: bool) -> None:

   119	class _FcntlLock:
   120	    def __init__(self, path: Path) -> None:
   121	        self.path = Path(path)
   122	        self._handle: Any | None = None
   123	
   124	    def acquire(self, timeout: float | None = None) -> "_FcntlLock":
   125	        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   126	        self._handle = self.path.open("a+b")
   127	        deadline = None if timeout is None or timeout < 0 else time.monotonic() + timeout
   128	        while True:
   129	            try:
   130	                fcntl.flock(self._handle.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
   131	                return self
   132	            except BlockingIOError as exc:
   133	                if timeout == 0 or (deadline is not None and time.monotonic() >= deadline):
   134	                    raise Timeout(str(self.path)) from exc
   135	                time.sleep(0.05)
   136	
   137	    def release(self) -> None:
   138	        if self._handle is None:
   139	            return
   140	        fcntl.flock(self._handle.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_UN)
   141	        self._handle.close()
   142	        self._handle = None
   143	
   144	    def __enter__(self) -> "_FcntlLock":
   145	        return self.acquire()
   146	
   147	    def __exit__(self, exc_type: object, exc: object, tb: object) -> None:
   148	        self.release()
   149	
   150	
   151	def _lock_for(path: Path) -> Any:
   152	    lock_path = Path(str(path) + ".lock")
   153	    if FileLock is not None:
   154	        return FileLock(str(lock_path))
   155	    return _FcntlLock(lock_path)

   159	    return utc_now_iso()

   166	def _cache_dir() -> Path:
   167	    root = Path(os.environ.get("HYPE_CACHE_DIR", "~/.cache/banodoco-hype")).expanduser()
   168	    path = root / "assets"

   173	def _basename_for(url: str) -> str:
   174	    parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(url)
   175	    name = Path(urllib.parse.unquote(parsed.path)).name or "asset"
   176	    stem = Path(name).stem or "asset"
   177	    suffix = Path(name).suffix
   178	    safe_stem = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "_", stem).strip("._-") or "asset"
   179	    safe_suffix = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9.]+", "", suffix)
   180	    digest = hashlib.sha1(url.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:16]
   181	    return f"{digest}__{safe_stem}{safe_suffix}"
   182

   184	def _path_for(url: str) -> Path:
   185	    return _cache_dir() / _basename_for(url)

   192	def _read_meta(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:

   196	    try:

   203	def _write_meta(path: Path, meta: dict[str, Any]) -> None:

   206	    tmp_path.write_text(json.dumps(meta, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
   207	    os.replace(tmp_path, meta_path)

   210	def _touch_accessed(path: Path) -> None:

   218	def _head(url: str) -> dict[str, str]:
   219	    request = urllib.request.Request(url, method="HEAD")
   220	    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
   221	        return {key.lower(): value for key, value in response.headers.items()}

   224	def _get(url: str, *, start: int = 0) -> tuple[Any, dict[str, str]]:
   225	    headers = {"Range": f"bytes={start}-"} if start > 0 else {}
   226	    request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=headers, method="GET")
   227	    response = urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=60)
   228	    return response, {key.lower(): value for key, value in response.headers.items()}

   231	def _drift_mode() -> str:
   232	    mode = os.environ.get("HYPE_DRIFT_MODE", "strict").strip().lower()
   233	    return mode if mode in {"strict", "warn", "refetch"} else "strict"
   234	
   235	
   236	def _handle_drift(path: Path, expected: str, actual: str, *, allow_refetch: bool) -> bool:
   237	    message = f"Content drift for {path}: expected sha256 {expected}, got {actual}"
   238	    mode = _drift_mode()
   239	    if mode == "warn":
   240	        print(f"warning: {message}", file=sys.stderr)
   241	        return False
   242	    if mode == "refetch" and allow_refetch:
   243	        with contextlib.suppress(FileNotFoundError):
   244	            path.unlink()
   245	        with contextlib.suppress(FileNotFoundError):
   246	            _meta_path(path).unlink()
   247	        return True
   248	    raise ContentDriftError(message)

   251	def _download_once(url: str, path: Path, expected_sha256: str | None, head_meta: dict[str, str]) -> Path:
   252	    partial_path = Path(str(path) + ".partial")
   253	    existing = partial_path.stat().st_size if partial_path.exists() else 0
   254	    response, get_meta = _get(url, start=existing)
   255	    status = getattr(response, "status", None)
   256	    mode = "ab" if existing > 0 and status == 206 else "wb"
   257	    try:
   258	        with response, partial_path.open(mode) as output:
   259	            shutil.copyfileobj(response, output, length=1024 * 1024)
   260	    finally:
   261	        response.close()
   262	
   263	    actual_sha256 = sha256_file(partial_path)
   264	    if expected_sha256 and actual_sha256 != expected_sha256:
   265	        raise ContentDriftError(f"Content drift for {url}: expected sha256 {expected_sha256}, got {actual_sha256}")
   266	
   267	    fetched_at = _now()
   268	    os.replace(partial_path, path)
   269	    content_length = get_meta.get("content-length") or head_meta.get("content-length")
   270	    meta: dict[str, Any] = {
   271	        "url": url,
   272	        "etag": get_meta.get("etag") or head_meta.get("etag"),
   273	        "content_length": int(content_length) if content_length and content_length.isdigit() else path.stat().st_size,
   274	        "content_sha256": actual_sha256,
   275	        "fetched_at": fetched_at,
   276	        "accessed_at": fetched_at,
   277	    }
   278	    old_meta = _read_meta(path)
   279	    if isinstance(old_meta.get("url_expires_at"), str):
   280	        meta["url_expires_at"] = old_meta["url_expires_at"]
   281	    _write_meta(path, meta)
   282	    return path
